title: Software Development Manager - Clinic Marketing
descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Hi, I'm Kristien, and I lead the Booking Group at Jane. I started out as a developer more than 20 years ago, and my background in human-computer interaction still shapes how I lead. I care a lot about clarity, empathy, and accountability, and I've found they make each other stronger. I love building teams that can take on hard problems and keep their humanity along the way.

Our Clinic Marketing team looks after Jane Websites, which takes a clinic's setup in Jane and turns it into a marketing website for them. Now we're thinking bigger. The team is exploring what AI can do for website generation. We're also building tools that help clinics make sense of their own marketing, like which numbers to watch and what they actually mean. Most practitioners got into their field to care for people, so helping them grow their practice without having to become marketing experts is a lovely way to help the helpers.

A lot of this work is brand new. That means shaping ideas from scratch, testing them with customers, and iterating quickly. We're looking for a Development Manager who loves that kind of zero-to-one work. You'll lead a talented team of developers and work closely with product and design as part of the team's triad. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to guide architecture, and you'll help every person on the team grow.

If building something new with a team that cares about its craft sounds like your kind of fun, I'd love to meet you.


The Impact You Could Have

  • Lead and grow a team of developers, coaching them on technical and professional skills so each person keeps building their craft and their career.

  • Partner closely with product and design from the earliest conversations: dig into use cases, shape scope, and work out what data we need to capture.

  • Drive zero-to-one product work, helping the team take ambiguous ideas through prototypes to shipped features our clinics love.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to architecture reviews, helping the team make thoughtful decisions that hold up as the product grows.

  • Own delivery for the team and keep work moving with a clear sense of priority and a healthy bias to action.

  • Help the team find the right pace, knowing when to move fast and experiment and when to slow down and get something right.

  • Champion pragmatic, responsible AI adoption, both in the experiences we build for clinics and in how the team works day to day.


The Experience We Feel We Need

  • You spent several years as a hands-on software developer, and you've since grown into leading a development team as a people manager.

  • You have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable reviewing architecture, weighing tradeoffs, and guiding technical direction alongside senior and staff developers.

  • You've taken at least one product from zero to one, and you're comfortable with the fast iteration and ambiguity that come with building something new.

  • You're deeply collaborative and enjoy working in a triad with product and design, getting into the details early and shaping the work together.

  • You're energized by coaching and have a couple of good examples of helping people on your team grow.

  • You stay steady under pressure, take ownership, and know how to move work forward until it's delivered.

  • You've used AI tools in your own work or with your team, and you bring a curious, practical view of where they add real value.

  • Experience with marketing tools, website builders, or analytics products is a nice bonus, but it isn't required.

If you don't meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.


More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company born in North Vancouver, British Columbia. We're now a team of more than 800 people working remotely across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go.

We're also embracing the possibilities of AI, using it to work smarter, improve our systems, and create even better experiences for our customers and our team.

Our goal isn't just delivery, it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.


Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we're committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $158,400 to $247,500. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of $188,100. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You'll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You're also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package. You can learn more about it here!

Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.
